"Create a complete, fully playable 3D cake decorating game called CAKE STUDIO.

GAME CONCEPT
The player owns a cute, colorful cake studio. The entire purpose of the game is to create, bake, decorate, and customize beautiful cakes. Make the game feel like a polished mobile decorating game.

VISUAL STYLE

- Beautiful 3D graphics.
- Cute pastel aesthetic.
- Smooth animations.
- Realistic-looking frosting and cake textures.
- Pink, cream, lavender, baby blue, and pastel yellow colors.
- Clean, modern user interface.
- Soft lighting and satisfying visual effects.

GAMEPLAY

1. CAKE CREATION

- Choose between round, square, heart-shaped, and tiered cakes.
- Choose cake sizes.
- Select cake flavors such as vanilla, chocolate, strawberry, red velvet, and lemon.
- Allow players to choose different cake layers.

2. FROSTING

- Apply frosting using interactive decorating tools.
- Choose frosting colors.
- Mix custom colors.
- Add smooth frosting, whipped frosting, and textured frosting.
- Allow players to cover the entire cake.

3. DECORATING
   Include lots of decorations:

- Strawberries
- Cherries
- Blueberries
- Raspberries
- Chocolate pieces
- Sprinkles
- Pearls
- Edible flowers
- Bows
- Candles
- Ribbons
- Hearts
- Stars
- Macarons
- Mini cookies

Players must be able to position, rotate, resize, and remove decorations.

4. DECORATING TOOLS
   Include:

- Piping bags
- Spatulas
- Frosting brushes
- Cake scrapers
- Sprinkle shakers
- Drizzle bottles

Each tool should have its own working interaction.

5. GAME MODES

Free Decorate: Create any cake without restrictions.

Customer Orders: Customers request specific cakes. Players recreate the requested designs and earn coins.

Cake Challenges: Complete themed decorating challenges.

My Gallery: Save and view previously created cakes.

6. PROGRESSION

- Earn coins from completed orders.
- Unlock new frosting colors.
- Unlock decorations.
- Unlock cake shapes.
- Unlock new tools.
- Allow players to customize their cake studio.

IMPORTANT GAME REQUIREMENTS

- Make this a REAL playable game, not a static screen or mockup.
- Every button must work.
- Every decorating tool must function.
- Decorations must actually appear on the cake.
- Players must be able to interact with the cake directly.
- Add smooth transitions between menus.
- Make the game mobile-friendly.
- Do not leave unfinished buttons or placeholder features.
- Do not make the game a slideshow.

CAMERA
Use a close-up 3D camera focused on the cake and decorating workspace. Allow players to rotate and zoom around their cake.

The cake should remain the main focus of the entire experience.

Make the final result feel like a complete, polished, professional cake decorating game.

---

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Complete and validate a polished, playable, mobile-friendly 3D cake decorating game called CAKE STUDIO.

## Requirements
- Support cake customization, six functional tools, decoration placement/editing/removal, orders, challenges, gallery, progression, studio customization, and camera controls.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Use Three.js via CDN, plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript, and localStorage persistence.
- Start players with 240 coins; shapes and tools are available immediately, with shimmer frosting and gold-leaf decoration purchasable.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the responsive interface and game logic in `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `app.js`.
- Fixed the zero-height `#threeMount` by sizing it to fill `.cake-stage`.
- Fixed cake-top raycasting: cap meshes now have `userData.cakeSurface=true`, allowing taps to place decorations.
- Confirmed `node --check app.js` passes and multiple Strawberry decorations place successfully in Chromium.

### Active
- Validate decoration selection/editing/removal, tools, orders, challenges, gallery, studio purchases, and persistence.
- Check mobile layout and capture and inspect a current small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test decoration selection, resize/rotate/delete, undo/redo, and the six tools.
2. Validate orders, challenges, gallery, purchases, and localStorage persistence.
3. Check mobile layout, capture a fresh small JPEG screenshot, and inspect only that latest image.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game interface and module entry point.
- `styles.css`: Responsive interface styling; includes the `#threeMount` sizing fix.
- `app.js`: Three.js scene, raycasting, cake geometry, and game logic; includes the cake-cap raycast fix.
